name: Seated Forward Fold

instructions.description: Sit on the floor with both legs extended and spine tall.
Hinge forward from the hips while reaching your hands toward the legs or floor.
Keep the chest long and stop before the back rounds excessively.
Breathe steadily, then return upright slowly.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a comfortable stretch range without forcing the end position.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Bend one knee if both legs straight creates too much tension.

commentsNotes: A slight knee bend is acceptable.
